Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 7 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 05 September 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales(Santa Cruz, Candelaria, Masinloc, Palauig, Iba).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Tarlac, Nueva Ecija, Bulacan, Metro Manila, Cavite and Batangas within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Bataan, Pampanga, Quezon, Zambales(Olongapo, Subic, Botolan, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Castillejos, San Antonio, San Felipe, San Narciso), Laguna(Santa Maria, Siniloan, Famy, Mabitac, Pangil, Pakil, Paete, Kalayaan) and Rizal(Jala-Jala, Pililla, Tanay, Rodriguez) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

data.text:
👇🔥🔥🔥
Trixie Cruz Angeles

MAJOR PASABOG!

Cong. Ungab dropped a major pasabog in Congress today concerning the Official Development Assistance or Foreign Assisted Projects. 

Uulitin natin, ha? Pera ito na pinahiram o ini-grant galing sa ibang bansa o foreign organizations.

Nakalaan and ODA/FAP para sa mga ito:

1. Metro Manila Flood Management Project (MMFMP) – High-
impact initiative to reduce flood risk in the National Capital Region; ₱6.0B (2024) and ₱6.8B (2025).

2. Pasig-Marikina Channel Improvement Project (PMRIP) – Major
flood control infrastructure; ₱6.6B (2024) and ₱7.4B (2025).

3. Cavite Industrial Area Flood Risk Management Project (CIA-
FRMP) – Strategic flood prevention for an industrial hub; ₱1.7B (2024) and ₱ 5.9B (2025).

4. Flood Risk Management Project for Cagayan de Oro River –
Protection of urban and riverine communities; ₱3.6B (2024) and ₱1.2B
(2025).

5. Integrated Flood Resilience and Adaptation Project (IFRAP) –
Encompassing the Abra River Basin, Agus River Basin (Lanao del Norte), and Tagum–Libuganon River Basin (Davao del Norte); ₱420M (2024) and ₱3.1B (2025).

Pero ang nangyari ay tila BINAKLAS ang mga malalaking items na ito.   

Kung titignan ninyo yung table sa baba, nakalagay yung amount na nakalaan sa proyekto galing sa National Expenditure Program. At makikita ninyo kung magkano ang ultimately lumitaw sa General Appropriations Act. 

Hindi kayo namamalikmata. From billions to zero sa 2024. Sa 2025 mula P27billion, P9 billion lang ang naiwan para sa mga tao. 

Hinala ni Cong. Ungab, dinistribute sa mga CONGRESSIONAL districts. Ginawang maliliit na proyekto na district-based, at hindi nag address ng flood control SYSTEM. 

Hindi lang baha ang purpose ng mga proyekto na ito. Ito yung advanced planning para sa mitigation ng effects ng climate change.

WALANGHIYA ANG MGA GUMAWA NITO. Kailangan nang imbestigahan na ang mga mamababatas na sankot dito.
